topology: SW1 Gi0/24 ↔ SW2 Gi0/23, then SW2 Gi0/24 ↔ SW3 Gi0/24. Six prepared PCs form three pairs in VLANs 10,20,99 at 192.168.<VLAN>.11/.12 /24. Access ports Gi0/1, Gi0/2, Gi0/3 carry those VLANs on each edge switch. No inter-VLAN routing or default gateways are required.
preparedFaults: SW1 Gi0/24 and SW2 Gi0/23 both dynamic auto, with DTP enabled
SW2 Gi0/24 allowed list omits VLAN 20
SW3 Gi0/24 native VLAN 1 rather than 99
SW3 Gi0/1 assigned VLAN 20 rather than 10
verificationNotes: Practice starts at zero tasks with three real diagnosis actions enabled. The completed reference starts with eight configuration/save/forwarding tasks and empty runtime; traffic and MAC accomplishments are never prefilled.

Six repair goals remain live. Static trunk/nonegotiate, exact VLAN lists, matched native VLANs, active VLANs, correct access membership and administrative state are checked independently. The startup-save goal requires all six repairs plus matching relevant running/startup Layer 2 policy on all three switches.

The forwarding task requires normal STP, no inter-switch PortFast, and forwarding for VLANs 10,20,99 on all four trunk endpoints. Actual delivery is tested after shutdown, auto/auto, pruning, native mismatch, VLAN suspension, access-VLAN and cable faults.

Historical traffic predicates correlate accepted destination echo requests with source replies via parent packet ID, then require those request/reply IDs at both send and receive ends of both physical trunk segments. VLAN10/20 require tags; native99 requires no tag in both directions. Unrelated replies, missing transit events, wrong targets and incorrect tags fail direct evidence checks.

The live MAC goal requires twelve current dynamic entries: three remote sources per edge switch and six direction-correct entries on SW2. Clearing or expiration loses the goal. Reopening retains eleven goals and requires fresh pair traffic to relearn MACs. Actual IOS reload restores saved allowed-list policy after unsaved damage.

All advertised IOS repair and verification commands run against the simulator. This task adds no networking-engine commands or success stubs. Cisco trunk documentation informed the lab design; no new CML capture was claimed or required for this catalog addition.

New ENCOR Layer 2 section navigation, singular lab count, independent group section memory and base-URL-preserving permalinks are tested. Three existing Virtualization labs remain in their section. Prior VRF/GRE/IPsec catalog expectations are scoped to the appropriate section.

Chrome file:// matrix covers light/dark at 1440,390,320px, real console entry, real failed and successful traffic, all twelve tasks, live regression/repair, saved progress, completed reference, cancel/save-copy protection and exact terminal golden styles. Two additional permalink checks preserve host, path and query without replacing the current workspace.
